quest.title: Their Childhood: Time Waits for No One
quest.description: You meet Aurele and Verut once again in the Court of Fontaine. They seem to be playing some game again...

talks.objective: Ask the two brothers on the ground

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Brother, let's hide over there. I bet it'll be better than the location she picked!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Hey, Verut, stay close to me! If you get lost, I won't be able to find you right away, you know!

choices.text: What are you two doing here?

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Hey, it's you! Are you free by any chance? C'mon, hide with us! Lovi's probably hidden herself already.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tell me about Lovi...

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: There's no time, c'mon! She knows this place really well... We need to find a better hiding spot!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Verut leaves in a hurry...

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: *sigh* Verut... When will he listen...

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Sorry, but I'll have to trouble you to go another round with us. Verut's really excited, for... whatever reason...

choices.text: Maybe it's because he's found a new friend.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: My thoughts exactly. Still, so long as he's happy, it's all good...

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Let's hope he doesn't get too excited and follow Lovi to hide in some strange spot or another...

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: My apologies, but please, do play hide-and-seek with us again.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: I guess I should find a place to hide myself, or Verut will be upset... and if he cries right in the middle of the street, I'll be all out of options...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Aurele leaves...

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: A girl we just met. She saw us playing hide-and-seek, and she insisted on joining in.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Her personality's quite like Verut's, so they get along like a house on fire.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: In any case, her father doesn't seem to have much time to play with her either, so I guess we're all in the same boat there.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: ...I think I've read this page before.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Huh. You sure arrived quickly. I had only just started reading.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Lovi's father got her to pass this book to me. He even said that I could ask him about anything I didn't understand in it.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: But in truth... Heh. What is there in this book that I *do* understand...

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Anyway, leaving that aside, I'll head back to our meeting point. You did find me, after all, and the rules are the rules.

choices.text: You're quite an avid learner, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Agh, you found me so quickly! I was just planning on switching locations...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Now I'll have to go back to the meeting point...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Ugh, so you found me... Huh? Wait, who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A friend of Aurele and Verut.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Oh! They mentioned you before... Verut said you're really good at this.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Well, guess I got to see it for myself today. You really are good at this, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: You got me good. Guess I'll head back to the meeting spot, then.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: You were secretly reading a book again, weren't you? You weren't playing seriously at all!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: That's right. Come on! Be serious!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Well, the two of you took the good spots, and I'm not very good at this... so I just went to read to pass the time, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Bleh! You're a lying liar!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Hmph! Bookworm!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Seriously? Spare me...

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Hehe, Lovi's really good at hide-and-seek. She knows all sorts of interesting hiding spots.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Hehehe, this place is pretty awesome when Lovi's around!

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: Verut climbs walls super fast, and he's really strong. He gave me a hand quite a few times.

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: As long as we go together, I bet no one but you would be able to find us!

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Alright, I think we're more or less done for the day. Let's send you home first, Lovi.

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: And then... you're gonna ask my dad questions again, right?

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: W—Well, there are some things that I'll need to consult him about, you know...

response.speaker: Lovi
response.text: Well, sure, my dad's definitely going to be home right now, so let's head back. My mom said that the two of you should stay for dinner, you know...

choices.text: Weren't you two having fun anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: You found me again...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Verut's right, you're no ordinary person...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: You got me good. Guess I'll head back to the meeting spot, then.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: This page is about...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Can't find me...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Hehe, not gonna catch me!

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: I'm not gonna get found this time, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: No problems here...
